frequency_question: How often does a proposed major central ministry industrial/automotive green transition scheme successfully transition from policy announcement to formal notification and implementation within a 3-year window?
membership_rule: Includes central ministry initiatives targeting electric vehicles, advanced chemistry cells, or green manufacturing subsidies with formal financial outlays. Excludes state-level policies and minor administrative tweaks.
